amp_bioactivity.origin_evidence: Hb-I purified from 200 g of the species' own mantle (Section 3.3); N-terminal Edman sequencing plus a cloned 441-nt ORF identical to GenBank AB713934 (Section 2.2). The 14-mer is a tryptic fragment of that haemoglobin (Sections 2.3, 3.5). Independent check: AB713934.1 ORGANISM is Anadara broughtonii (taxon 148819) and its translation BAM63323.1 holds DLRDSWKVIGSDKK as an exact contiguous segment at residues 18-31.
amp_bioactivity.material_evidence: Section 3.6: synthesized by GL Biochem (Shanghai), solid-phase Fmoc chemistry, HPLC and MS purity above 95%.
amp_bioactivity.assay_evidence: Section 3.7: modified NCCLS broth microdilution in 96-well plates, 90 uL LB broth + 100 uL inoculum (1e5 CFU/mL) + 10 uL sample, 37 C 18 h, A600; two-fold dilutions 0.5-1600 ug/mL. The paper's disc-diffusion zone diameters (Section 3.2) are not MIC and are not used.
amp_bioactivity.species_check: The paper prints Arca inflata Reeve, 1844; WoRMS marks it unaccepted with the accepted name Anadara broughtonii (537824 -> 504357), as it does Scapharca broughtonii (591364 -> 504357). Material bought at Chengyang seafood market, Qingdao, China and identified by the authors (Section 3.1).
amp_bioactivity.verification: Full text and Table 3 parsed from the Europe PMC XML on 2026-10-02 by two agents independently; the second re-read the XML after a summarizer mis-transcribed the P. aeruginosa and B. subtilis values. Table 2's published masses (1583.81 / 1646.86 / 1572.87 Da) reproduce from the sequences with ExPASy average residue masses.

amp_bioactivity.origin_evidence: TS40 is residues 187-226 of SsTFPI-2, the tissue factor pathway inhibitor 2 homologue the authors cloned from the black rockfish's own genome (Methods, bioinformatics section).
amp_bioactivity.material_evidence: Methods, peptide synthesis: synthesized by China Peptides (Suzhou), HPLC purity above 95%.
amp_bioactivity.assay_evidence: Methods, antibacterial assay: 96-well broth microdilution, two-fold serial dilutions, LB medium, inoculum 2e5 CFU/mL, 24 h; Table 2 gives MIC and MBC in uM. The paper's inhibition-zone results are not MIC and are not used.
amp_bioactivity.species_check: WoRMS 274849 Sebastes schlegelii Hilgendorf, 1880 (accepted). The paper spells the epithet 'schlegeli' in places; the taxon is the same.
amp_bioactivity.assay_note: The paper names no strain collection number for its laboratory strains, so the strain field is null. The cohort is built per target species, not per strain, and the CLSI-medium cohort is kept as a sensitivity because this assay used LB, not MHB.
amp_bioactivity.verification: Full text and Table 2 parsed from the Europe PMC XML of PMC9228364, 2026-10-02.

excluded.record: MCCC1-MTS, Hong et al. 2025, Int J Mol Sci 26:8546 (PMC12429151)
excluded.reason: MIC 32 ug/mL (14.1 uM) against E. coli KCCM 11234 and S. aureus KCCM 40881 by Mueller-Hinton broth microdilution, chemically synthesized by Anygen with purity above 90%; but neither the paper nor its supplementary files print the amino-acid sequence (Figure 1B and S1 give a helix wheel and the gene name only). Without the sequence there is no cohort member key and no way to check the mass, so the row cannot be scored.
Their papers assayed recombinant proteins (for example 'the recombinant PtALF7 protein exhibited antimicrobial activity'), which the rule excludes.

excluded.record: crab-ALF2A, crab-ALF6A, ALF6A8 (Nam et al. 2019, Fish Shellfish Immunol 84:664)
excluded.reason: Synthetic, but the reported value is MEC from a radial-diffusion assay on BHI agar, not MIC by broth microdilution; the abstract also says the natural sequence was modified.
Every DBAASP MIC row for it is censored or a range (<0.3, >19.2, 1.2-2.4, 9.6-19.2 uM), which the rule drops, and the full text is subscription-only, so the material and method could not be checked.
Synthetic and sequence published, but the paper reports immune activity on THP-1 cells and no MIC at all.
